name: Christmas at Tivoli
blurb: Central amusement park dressed up as a Christmas fairground, with lights, a market and rides (rides cost extra).
priceText: DKK 210 adult entry per a 2026 travel guide (varies by date); rides extra
when: 13 Nov 2026–3 Jan 2027, daily; hours vary by day (see tivoli.dk); closed 24 Dec per travel guides

name: Julemarked at Nytorv and Gammeltorv (free ice rink)
blurb: Christmas market on two old squares on the Strøget walking street, with a free ice rink and free skate hire.
priceText: Free entry; ice rink and skate hire free per a 2026 travel guide
when: 6 Nov–21 Dec 2026 (dates from a travel guide, not yet checked with the organiser)

name: FC København vs FC Lugano (UEFA Conference League)
blurb: European night at Parken as FCK host Swiss side Lugano; FCK sells three-match European bundles from 350 DKK.
when: Thu 10 Dec 2026, 18:45 CET, Parken stadium

name: Brøndby IF vs OB (Superliga)
blurb: Danish league home game for Brøndby IF against OB, just west of Copenhagen; the last league round before the winter break.
when: Sun 6 Dec 2026, about 16:00 CET, Brøndby Stadium

name: Christmas Market at Skansen
blurb: Weekend Christmas market inside the Skansen open-air museum, among relocated historic wooden buildings.

name: Stortorget Christmas Market (Gamla Stan)
blurb: Small traditional Christmas market on the Old Town's oldest square; stalls with crafts, sweets and mulled wine.
when: Usually c. 21 Nov–23 Dec; Sun–Thu 11:00–18:00, Fri–Sat 11:00–19:00 (2026 dates expected, not yet confirmed)

name: Meet Lucia at Storkyrkan (Stockholm Cathedral)
blurb: Candlelit Lucia procession with youth choirs singing Lucia and Staffan songs in the cathedral in Gamla Stan.
when: 6 Dec 15:00 and 17:00, 8 Dec 18:00 (listing spans 6–13 Dec; Lucia Day is 13 Dec)

name: Christmas at Liseberg (Jul på Liseberg)
blurb: Amusement park turned Sweden's biggest Christmas market: five million lights, ~2,000 trees, themed markets and ice skating.
when: Opens 14 Nov 2026, runs to 30 Dec; entry price for the Christmas season not yet published

name: Julstaden Göteborg: Haga Christmas market and city lights
blurb: City-wide Christmas celebration with lights across the centre and a market on the cobbled Haga Nygata street.
priceText: Free to walk around (street market and lights)
when: Usually mid-Nov through December (Liseberg's Christmas opens 14 Nov); no 2026 programme found

name: Helsinki Christmas Market (Tuomaan Markkinat)
blurb: Traditional Christmas market on Senate Square beneath the cathedral, with craft stalls, food and hot glögi.
when: 27 Nov–22 Dec 2026; Mon–Thu and Sun 11:00–19:00, Fri–Sat 11:00–20:00

name: Independence Day Torchlight Procession
blurb: Students march with torches from Hietaniemi Cemetery to Senate Square on Finland's Independence Day; all welcome.
when: Sun 6 Dec 2026; wreath-laying 15:30, procession leaves Hietaniemi Cemetery chapel about 16:30, ends about 18:00

name: Finland's Lucia coronation and procession
blurb: Finland's national Lucia is crowned in Helsinki Cathedral, followed by a candlelit procession through the centre.
when: Sun 13 Dec (Lucia Day); coronation about 17:00 at the cathedral (2024 timing), then the procession

name: Tallinn Christmas Market (Town Hall Square)
blurb: Old Town market around the big Christmas tree: knitwear, wooden crafts, gingerbread and mulled wine.
when: 20 Nov 2026–6 Jan 2027, daily; tree lights go on the first Advent Sunday (29 Nov)

name: Riga Old Town Christmas Market (Doma Square)
blurb: Old Town Christmas market on Doma Square with wooden huts, gingerbread, Santa's cabin, a carousel and evening concerts.

name: Latvian National Opera and Ballet: Giselle, Aida and Carmen nights
blurb: Opera and ballet evenings in Riga's national theatre; the Nutcracker runs 5–18 Dec but all its dates are sold out.
when: Giselle 10 Dec, Aida 11 Dec, Carmen 17 Dec 2026 (all 19:00); Midsummer Night's Dream ballet 9 Dec

name: Vilnius Christmas Market (Cathedral Square)
blurb: 48 wooden huts on Cathedral Square beside the city's award-winning Christmas tree; a Christmas train circles the Old Town.
when: 28 Nov–27 Dec 2026; tree lighting 28 Nov; Christmas train runs 28 Nov–6 Jan

name: Vilnius Christmas Run
blurb: Annual festive run through Vilnius's decorated streets; check the organisers for registration and route.
when: Sat 5 Dec 2026 (start time not listed)

name: Paquita ballet at the Lithuanian National Opera and Ballet Theatre
blurb: Classical ballet in the national theatre's main hall; seven performances in the window, about 2 h 10 min with one interval.

name: Gdańsk Christmas Fair (Jarmark Bożonarodzeniowy)
blurb: Big Christmas fair centred on Targ Węglowy with extra zones along the Royal Way; craft stalls and food from many cuisines.
when: Planned 20 Nov–23 Dec 2026 (2025: 21 Nov–23 Dec); last year Sun–Thu 12:00–20:00, Fri–Sat to 21:00

name: Kraków Christmas Market (Main Market Square)
blurb: Poland's oldest Christmas market, on the Main Market Square, with craft stalls and grzaniec (mulled wine).
when: Planned 27 Nov 2026–3 Jan 2027 (organiser says it may run to 6 Jan); daily

name: Cracovia vs Lech Poznań (Ekstraklasa)
blurb: League home game for Cracovia, one of Kraków's two big clubs, against Lech Poznań; kick-off still to be set.
when: Sat 12 Dec 2026 (round 18; kick-off time not yet set)

name: Warsaw Christmas Market (Plac Defilad, Palace of Culture)
blurb: Big Christmas fair under the Palace of Culture and Science with craft stalls, food, a Ferris wheel and carousel (rides extra).
priceText: Free entry (rides such as the Sky 55 wheel cost extra)
when: 20 Nov 2026–6 Jan 2027 per city listing (its text partly recycles 2025/26); 2025 hours Mon–Thu to 21:00, Fri–Sat to 22:00

name: Legia Warszawa vs Pogoń Szczecin (Ekstraklasa)
blurb: League home game for Warsaw's best-known club; the official kick-off time is still to be set.
when: Sat 12 Dec 2026 (round 18; kick-off time not yet set)

name: Wrocław Christmas Market (Market Square)
blurb: Christmas market spread across the Market Square, Salt Square and nearby streets; craft stalls, food and mulled wine.
when: 20 Nov 2026–7 Jan 2027, daily 10:00–21:00; closed 24–25 Dec and 1 Jan, 26 Dec from 13:00

name: Śląsk Wrocław vs Górnik Zabrze (Ekstraklasa)
blurb: League home game for Śląsk, Wrocław's top football club, against Górnik Zabrze; kick-off time still to be set.
when: Sat 12 Dec 2026 (round 18; kick-off time not yet set)

name: Poznań Christmas Market (Betlejem Poznańskie, Old Market Square)
blurb: Christmas fair on Poznań's Old Market Square, with craft stalls, food and mulled wine.
when: Planned 21 Nov 2026–6 Jan 2027 (dates exclude set-up and dismantling)

name: Lech Poznań vs Ferencváros (UEFA Europa League)
blurb: European night at Enea Stadion as Lech host Hungary's Ferencváros in the Europa League league phase.
priceText: PLN 140 normal in the cheapest category (Białasa i Kocioł stands); reduced PLN 112 for students aged 13–26
when: Thu 10 Dec 2026, 21:00, Enea Stadion

name: Christmas Garden Berlin (Botanical Garden light trail)
blurb: Illuminated walking trail through Berlin's Botanical Garden with light installations; open-air, timed-slot tickets.
priceText: Adult from EUR 16.90 online (up to 27.90; box office 29.90); students from 12.90 Mon–Thu only (not 18 Dec–2 Jan), ID required
when: 18 Nov 2026–10 Jan 2027; tickets are for a booked day and time slot

name: WeihnachtsZauber Gendarmenmarkt
blurb: Upmarket Christmas market framed by the French and German cathedrals and the Konzerthaus on Gendarmenmarkt square.
priceText: EUR 2 entry; free Mon–Fri 12:00–14:00 (not 24–26 and 31 Dec); under 12s free

name: Lucia Christmas Market (Kulturbrauerei)
blurb: Scandinavian-style Christmas market in Prenzlauer Berg's old brewery, with open fires, a yurt and Nordic treats.
priceText: Free admission (Berlin city listing of free-entry markets)
when: 23 Nov–22 Dec 2026

name: Hertha BSC vs Darmstadt 98 (2. Bundesliga)
blurb: Second-division home game for Hertha at the Olympiastadion; the exact kick-off day and time are still to be set.
priceText: EUR 25–65 for the Fürth home game, EUR 30–75 for Bielefeld (club ticket news, 2026/27); Darmstadt prices not yet published
when: Sun 13 Dec 2026 (matchday 15; kick-off not yet scheduled, weekend of 11–13 Dec)

name: Hamburg Christmas Market at the Rathausmarkt
blurb: Historic Christmas market in front of Hamburg's City Hall, with stalls, food and mulled wine.
when: 23 Nov–23 Dec 2026; daily 11:00–21:00 (hours are listed under last year's dates)

name: Santa Pauli Christmas Market (Spielbudenplatz, Reeperbahn)
blurb: Cheeky, adult-themed Christmas market on the Reeperbahn with live bands, stage shows and the Winterdeck bar.

name: Hamburger Winterdom (fun fair on the Heiligengeistfeld)
blurb: Big winter fun fair next to the Reeperbahn with rides and food stalls; only its last days (to 6 Dec) fall in the window.
priceText: Free entry; rides and food extra
when: 6 Nov–6 Dec 2026; family offers every Wednesday

name: Hamburger SV vs Schalke 04 (Bundesliga)
blurb: Bundesliga home game for HSV against Schalke at the Volksparkstadion; exact kick-off day and time still to be set.
when: Sat 12 Dec 2026 (matchday 13; kick-off not yet scheduled, weekend of 11–13 Dec)

name: Munich Christkindlmarkt (Marienplatz)
blurb: Munich's main Christmas market on Marienplatz and Rindermarkt, with 130+ stalls and Advent music from the Town Hall balcony.

name: Munich Krampuslauf (Krampus run)
blurb: Parade of costumed Krampus figures through the Old Town from Augustinerstraße to the Old Town Hall; draws big crowds.
when: Sun 13 Dec 2026, 15:00–17:00; lines up at Augustinerstraße, ends at the Old Town Hall

name: Tollwood Winter Festival (Theresienwiese)
blurb: Alternative winter festival with about 200 fair-trade and craft stalls, organic food and ticketed shows in a big tent.
priceText: Free entry to grounds and market; show tickets extra (muenchenticket.de)
when: 24 Nov–23 Dec 2026; market Mon–Fri from 14:00, Sat–Sun from 11:00; shows: Triptych 2–9 Dec, Mad in Finland 12–20 Dec

name: FC Bayern vs Slavia Prague (UEFA Champions League)
blurb: Champions League league-phase night at the Allianz Arena; buy only through the club's official ticketing.
when: Tue 8 Dec 2026, about 21:00 CET, Allianz Arena

name: Cologne Cathedral Christmas Market (Roncalliplatz)
blurb: Cologne's best-known Christmas market in the cathedral's shadow, with a large tree, craft stalls and mulled wine.

name: Heinzels Wintermärchen (Alter Markt and Heumarkt ice rink)
blurb: Fairytale-themed Old Town Christmas market plus a 1,800 m² ice-skating landscape on the Heumarkt.
priceText: Market entry free; ice rink online day ticket EUR 9.50 Mon–Fri, 11.50 Sat/Sun, skate hire EUR 6.50
when: 23 Nov 2026–10 Jan 2027, daily 11:00–22:00; Alter Markt part ends 23 Dec, rink (Heumarkt) open to 10 Jan; closed 24–25 Dec

name: Markt der Engel (Neumarkt)
blurb: Angel-themed Christmas market on Neumarkt with white angel figures above the stalls; costumed characters for kids.
when: 16 Nov–23 Dec 2026; Sun–Thu 11:00–21:00, Fri–Sat 11:00–22:00; closed 22 Nov (Totensonntag)

name: 1. FC Köln vs RB Leipzig (Bundesliga)
blurb: Bundesliga home game for 1. FC Köln against RB Leipzig; the exact kick-off day and time are still to be set.
when: Sat 12 Dec 2026 (matchday 13; kick-off not yet scheduled, weekend of 11–13 Dec)

name: Frankfurt Christmas Market (Römerberg and city centre)
blurb: One of Germany's biggest Christmas markets, spread over Römerberg, Paulsplatz, Mainkai and other central squares.
when: 23 Nov–22 Dec 2026; Mon–Sat 10:00–21:00, Sun 11:00–21:00 per a travel listing

name: Eintracht Frankfurt vs Werder Bremen (Bundesliga)
blurb: Bundesliga home game for Eintracht against Werder Bremen; the exact kick-off day and time are still to be set.
when: Sat 5 Dec 2026 (matchday 12; kick-off not yet scheduled, weekend of 4–6 Dec)

name: Dresdner Striezelmarkt (592nd edition)
blurb: Claims to be Germany's oldest Christmas market: 200+ stalls with Saxon crafts, Stollen and Glühwein on the Altmarkt.

name: Dresdner Stollenfest (giant Stollen parade)
blurb: Annual festival of Dresden's Christmas Stollen with a big parade, the giant XXL Stollen and hundreds of bakers.
priceText: Free to watch (street parade and festival)
when: Sat 5 Dec 2026 (always the Saturday before 2nd Advent)

name: Christmas Garden Dresden (Pillnitz Palace light trail)
blurb: Illuminated winter trail through the grounds of Pillnitz Palace with light installations; timed-slot tickets.
priceText: Adult from EUR 15.90 online Mon–Thu (EUR 22.90 Fri–Sun); students EUR 10.90–14.90 Mon–Thu only, ID required
when: 19 Nov 2026–10 Jan 2027; tickets are for a booked day and time slot

name: Dynamo Dresden vs Energie Cottbus (2. Bundesliga)
blurb: Second-division home game for Dynamo Dresden against Energie Cottbus; the exact kick-off day and time are still to be set.
priceText: Standing EUR 21, reduced EUR 19 (students up to 25) at the Nov 2026 Fürth home game; Cottbus prices not yet published
when: Sun 13 Dec 2026 (matchday 15; kick-off not yet scheduled, weekend of 11–13 Dec)

name: Leipzig Christmas Market (Marktplatz and Augustusplatz)
blurb: City-centre Christmas market with about 300 stalls, a big tree on the Marktplatz, and a Finnish village and Ferris wheel.
when: 24 Nov–23 Dec 2026; opening ceremony 24 Nov on the Marktplatz; trombones from the Old Town Hall balcony daily

name: RB Leipzig vs Mainz 05 (Bundesliga)
blurb: Bundesliga home game for RB Leipzig against Mainz; the exact kick-off day and time are still to be set.
when: Sat 5 Dec 2026 (matchday 12; kick-off not yet scheduled, weekend of 4–6 Dec)

name: Nuremberg Christkindlesmarkt
blurb: Famous market on the Hauptmarkt with 180+ booths and endless gingerbread; the Christkind appears there Tue–Fri at 15:00.
when: 27 Nov–24 Dec 2026, daily 10:00–21:00 (24 Dec to 14:00); opened by the Christkind's prologue on 27 Nov

name: 1. FC Nürnberg vs VfL Bochum (2. Bundesliga)
blurb: Second-division home game for the Club (1. FC Nürnberg); the exact kick-off day and time are still to be set.
when: Sun 6 Dec 2026 (matchday 14; kick-off not yet scheduled, weekend of 4–6 Dec)
